# Social Interaction

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md)*

The Attitude rules and every attitude tagged [Attitude].

## Entries

- [Attitude](Attitude.md): A monster has a starting attitude toward a player character: Friendly, Hostile, or Indifferent.
- [Friendly [Attitude]](Friendly.md): A Friendly creature views you favorably.
- [Hostile [Attitude]](Hostile.md): A Hostile creature views you unfavorably.
- [Indifferent [Attitude]](Indifferent.md): An Indifferent creature has no desire to help or hinder you.
